Specific Pricing Term And Condition Directory
Priority or Override Rules : Rule Set
Product Term And Condition Type : ProductTermAndConditionType
Approval or Override Rules : Rule Set
Funding Source or Budget Allocation : Text
- Objective: Attract new student customers and increase debit card adoption at university campuses.
- Applicable Product/Service: Student Current Account + Debit Card
- Additional Incentive: Each new student gets a $25 bookstore voucher
-Eligibility Criteria: New student customers at Partner Universities A, B, and C, opening an account in September
-Authorization: Head of Retail Banking + Marketing Director
-Funding / Budget Allocation: All waived fees and voucher costs are charged to the campaign budget, not product P&L
-Priority/Override Rules: Overrides standard fees only for eligible accounts; all other accounts continue to be charged normally
